A morning of sign-in attempts from a school portal nobody has been reading. Three of them are attacks. Two look worse than they are, and telling them apart is the lab.
Everything runs in this page. The log and the account list are simulated, so read them in any order and as many times as you need.

Counting failures is the easy half. Four failures from a girl on her own laptop and one failure each across thirty accounts from a machine nobody recognises are not the same event, and the larger number is the innocent one. Work out what actually separates them before you decide which rows to flag.
This one is practice. It checks your work on the page and records nothing.
